snippet.description:
What would Chris Van Hollen do differently from Chuck Schumer as Senate Majority Leader? Van Hollen tells Vox’s Astead Herndon that Senate Democrats need a leader who fights for tax and health care reform, and stays out of contested Democratic primaries.
